claim.claim: Microsoft's net income for fiscal year 2025 increased by more than 10% compared with fiscal year 2024.

verdict.label: SUPPORTED
verdict.reasoning_summary: The claim states that Microsoft's net income for fiscal year 2025 increased by more than 10% compared with fiscal year 2024. Evidence E5, from Microsoft's 10-K filing for the period ending June 30, 2025, shows a comparison table for "Fiscal Year 2025 Compared with Fiscal Year 2024" which explicitly states net income was $101,832 million in FY2025 versus $88,136 million in FY2024, representing a 16% increase. Since 16% > 10%, the claim is supported.
